slug: 2026-03-31 Africa we have a data problem

facts.fact: Data Landscapers' 54-country review (an AI-assisted compilation, the author's analysis) states that a DHIS2-based EMIS was piloted in 2021 in Manzini region in 100 schools, rural primaries among them, with schools entering aggregate and individual PIN-tracked data over web and Android.
The review states that the 2021 Manzini pilot of the DHIS2-based EMIS included rural primary schools (it names Ekuthuleni and Mhlabubovu), some of which entered data.

The review states that rural primary schools record enrolment, attendance and learner profiles on paper forms and registers sent to regional or central level for manual entry, that it found no evidence of a majority of rural schools using digital entry routinely, and that digital use is limited to pilots and an early donor-supported rollout, scoring Eswatini schools 2 (mostly paper); the statement is undated, so the document's published date is used.

systems.tiers: schools in the 2021 Manzini pilot (100 schools); the 2024 national report is said to draw on DHIS2 data collected from schools
filled at schools, sent to regional and central levels for manual entry into legacy systems
